# The Lantern Keeper

Mara was Ivo's apprentice at Greyhaven lighthouse. During a storm, Ivo hurt his ankle and could not climb the tower. The Gull Star was approaching, and the harbour lantern was dark.

Magistrate Rusk told Mara to leave the lantern unlit so a rival's ship would miss the tide. When she refused, he threatened to stop her apprenticeship papers.

Mara was frightened, but she remembered that sailors depended on the light. She carried the spare oil up the tower and lit the lantern before the Gull Star reached Black Tooth Reef.

The captain saw the light, corrected course, and entered the harbour safely. Mara told Ivo about Rusk's threat, and the harbour council removed Rusk's authority over apprenticeship papers while it investigated him.

Then Ivo gathered every child in Greyhaven around Mara and announced the lesson of the night: good children always obey the rules, bad people always get punished, and anyone who does the right thing will certainly be rewarded. From then on, the town repeated that lesson at the lighthouse every evening.
